comment: Terminology table for Information Fusion English submission. FROZEN before translation begins. All claim-strength terms locked to match frozen Chinese manuscript.

查询路由.note: NEVER 'query router' as method name; use 'query-level routing' or 'query routing'

节点路由.note: or 'node routing'; refers to per-node model assignment

类型先验.note: stage-type prior baseline that matches node routing performance

静态执行.note: fixed plan with frozen local fallbacks

反馈条件化后继适应.note: the formal definition of Dynamic; NEVER 'online learning' or 'real-time replanning'

选择性调整.note: preserve strong default, only override with evidence

预算感知.note: residual budget constraints on recovery actions

传播能力.note: quality under actual upstream output; KEY DISTINCTION

接口表达能力.note: whether intermediate representations preserve necessary semantics

反馈可诊断性.note: whether runtime signals can detect actual failures

能力匹配.note: whether model strengths align with node requirements

三条件.note: conjunction, NOT a product model; always 'condition relation' not 'multiplicative model'

有限候选 Oracle.note: upper bound within enumerated candidate space only

差距恢复比例.note: GR(r;b) = (Q_r - Q_b)/(Q_Oracle - Q_b); NEVER call this 'accuracy'

严格配对分解基准.note: 300 tasks, three arms, single unified session

异构阶段分工.note: DAG-L/M arm; switching reasoning model after decomposition

同模型拆分.note: DAG-L/L arm; decomposition without model change

后继闭包.note: {v_i} ∪ Desc(v_i); the affected subgraph on failure

部署可得信号.note: parse/exec/consistency/unit-test; NO gold answers at runtime

支持性证据.note: USE THIS for MBPP +6.0pp; NEVER 'statistically significant' when McNemar p≥0.05

点估计.note: for Self-Refine 85% vs Dynamic 80%; paired difference NOT significant

反事实敏感性.note: hypothetical correction analysis, NOT a real result

任务分解.note: breaking a task into DAG nodes

能力解耦.note: DAG's core role: unbinding same-model stage coupling

claim_strength_rules.significant: ONLY when bootstrap CI excludes 0 AND exact McNemar p < 0.05
claim_strength_rules.supportive_evidence: bootstrap CI excludes 0 but McNemar p ≥ 0.05; or direction replicated across panels
claim_strength_rules.point_estimate_only: numerical difference reported without significance claim
claim_strength_rules.confirmed: pre-registered criterion met (e.g., cross-domain contrast upgrade rule)
claim_strength_rules.directionally_consistent: same sign across independent panels, magnitude similar, not confirmed

forbidden_phrases: Dynamic DAG significantly outperforms Static on MBPP
first to apply Pareto optimization to DAG scheduling
math tasks are unsuitable for DAG (over-generalization)

required_qualifiers.MBPP_dynamic: +6.0pp; bootstrap 95% CI [+1.0, +12.0] excludes zero, but exact McNemar p = 0.070; supportive evidence, not confirmed significant
required_qualifiers.decomposition_overall: DAG-L/M 31.7% still below Mono-L 38.7%; heterogeneous assignment mitigates but does not fully offset decomposition loss
required_qualifiers.math_collapse: on the frozen stratified Math-100 panel, both tested intermediate-representation interface families showed substantial performance degradation; NOT extrapolated to all math tasks
required_qualifiers.attribution_20pp: main gain from escalating failed nodes to strongest untried model (+18.3pp, Static-Matched); policy logic contributes only +1.7pp (ns)

terms_addendum_chapter4_v8._comment: Added after ch4 V8 freeze, before translation begins. Original frozen entries above are untouched.

质量保持率.note: rho_keep = 1 - Degradation; may exceed 1; never 'reliability score'

恢复率.note: per frozen failure/faulted denominator; Static post-injection correctness is 'survival rate', NEVER recovery

存活率.note: Static correct-after-injection without repair; do not merge with recovery rate

预算内正确完成率.note: post-hoc trajectory evaluation; not online hard budget gating

会话非确定性审计.note: same (model, prompt) divergence check across server sessions

策略切换边界.note: empirical, discrete tested points only; no continuous threshold claim

独占超体积贡献.note: HV(all) - HV(all minus point); zero for dominated strategies; scenario-relative only

能力基线.note: Single LLM category; distinct from workflow-execution baselines

工作流执行基线.note: Static DAG / Dynamic DAG / Full Replay category

持续性能力故障.note: bound to (task, node, planned model); same-model retry reproduces it

整图重执行.note: same detection/recovery rules as Dynamic-Real; scope-only difference
